    • transactionManager

      @Bean @Primary public org.springframework.transaction.PlatformTransactionManager transactionManager(DataSource dataSource)
      Transaction manager for the planmonitor-wonen database, used for @Transactional. Must be primary, otherwise the Spring Boot auto-configured transaction manager backs off because of the Spring Session transaction manager below and @Transactional would use the Tailormap database.
